items.raw_excerpt: More than 7,600 workers and engineers are racing to complete the expansion of Phu Quoc International Airport, which is scheduled to begin operations in April 2027 ahead of the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.
items.summary_en: More than 7,600 workers and engineers are racing to finish the expansion of Phu Quoc International Airport. The expanded airport is set to open in April 2027, before the APEC leaders' meeting. Phu Quoc is Vietnam's largest island.

items.raw_excerpt: Over five percent of six- to eight-year-old boys in Finland are taking medication for ADHD .
items.summary_en: More than five percent of boys aged six to eight in Finland now take medicine for ADHD. The number of young children using these drugs keeps growing. Doctors want to know why more boys need this help.
items.summary_ko: 핀란드에서 여섯 살에서 여덟 살 사이 남자아이 가운데 5퍼센트 넘게 ADHD 약을 복용하고 있어요. 이 약을 쓰는 어린아이가 계속 늘고 있습니다. 의사들은 왜 더 많은 남자아이에게 이런 도움이 필요한지 알고 싶어 해요.
items.title_en: More young boys in Finland are starting ADHD medicine
items.title_ko: 핀란드에서 ADHD 약을 먹기 시작하는 어린 남자아이가 늘고 있어요
items.title_original: More young boys starting ADHD medication

items.raw_excerpt: Eyewear chain Hans Anders will stop selling Meta camera glasses following demands from privacy advocates concerned about the so-called “pervert glasses”. The devices, the most popular version is sold by Meta, look like normal glasses but allow users to film and take photos covertly. Victim advocacy group Offlimits says it is helping hundreds of women who have been filmed without their consent, many of whom have seen those images distributed online or through social media groups. “Hiding a camera
items.summary_en: Eyewear chain Hans Anders will stop selling Meta camera glasses. Privacy groups worry these glasses let people film others in secret. A victim support group says it helps women who were filmed without consent.

items.raw_excerpt: The residents of Portadown's Garvaghy Road return to the courts this morning in a fresh attempt to overturn permission for an Orange Order parade.
items.summary_en: Residents of Garvaghy Road in Portadown are back in court today. They want to overturn a decision that allows an Orange Order parade. This is the latest step in a long local dispute.

items.raw_excerpt: Bafta-winning star Lenny Rush, 17, will play Dobby in HBO's upcoming series based on JK Rowling's books.
items.summary_en: Lenny Rush is 17 years old. He won a Bafta award. Now he will play Dobby in a new HBO series based on the Harry Potter books. He says his friends keep him grounded.

items.raw_excerpt: Jarbas Vasconcelos deixou a Prefeitura da Cidade do Recife em 1996 e foi o último ex-prefeito da capital que conseguiu se eleger governador do Estado
items.summary_en: Jarbas Vasconcelos left Recife City Hall in 1996. He was the last former mayor of the city to be elected governor of the state. No former Recife mayor has won the governor's race since then.

items.raw_excerpt: Sus calles de ripio, casas de estilo centroeuropeo, bosques y cascadas forman un paisaje que recuerda a una villa de los Alpes
items.summary_en: La Cumbrecita is a small town in Cordoba, Argentina where cars are not allowed. Its gravel streets, Central European houses, forests and waterfalls look like an Alpine village. About 500,000 tourists visit the town every year.
items.summary_ko: 라쿰브레시타는 아르헨티나 코르도바에 있는 작은 마을로, 마을 안에서는 차를 타고 다닐 수 없습니다. 자갈길과 중앙유럽풍 주택, 숲과 폭포가 어우러져 알프스의 작은 마을을 닮았습니다. 매년 약 50만 명의 관광객이 이곳을 찾습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Trận chung kết lượt về đầy kịch tính khép lại với tỷ số 2-2 trên sân Mỹ Đình, giúp đội tuyển Việt Nam vượt qua Thái Lan với tổng tỷ số 4-2 và bảo vệ thành công chức vô địch ASEAN Cup 2026. Tại phố đi bộ Nguyễn Huệ, hàng nghìn người hâm mộ vỡ òa, ôm nhau ăn mừng và hô vang “Việt Nam vô địch”.
items.source_name: Báo Tin tức và Dân tộc
items.summary_en: Vietnam drew 2-2 with Thailand in the ASEAN Cup 2026 final and won 4-2 on aggregate. Thousands of fans filled Nguyen Hue walking street, hugging and cheering for Vietnam.

items.raw_excerpt: Germany's national railway operator is extending its €99.99 family ticket beyond the summer season, giving eligible groups of up to five people a cheaper way to travel together.
items.summary_en: Germany's national railway is making its 99.99 euro family ticket a permanent offer. It was first planned only for the summer season. Groups of up to five people can now travel together for less all year round.
items.summary_ko: 독일 국영 철도가 99.99유로짜리 가족 티켓을 정식 상품으로 확대해 연중 운영하기로 했다. 이 티켓은 원래 여름 시즌에만 제공될 예정이었다. 앞으로 최대 다섯 명이 함께 여행할 때 더 저렴하게 이동할 수 있다.
items.title_en: Germany's family rail ticket is now a permanent offer
items.title_ko: 독일 국철 가족 티켓, 여름 한정 없이 연중 판매로
items.title_original: Deutsch Bahn makes its 'family ticket' a permanent offer

items.raw_excerpt: DA Joburg Caucus Spokesperson blames fuel shortages for Randburg waste vehicle shortage
items.summary_en: Fuel shortages caused a shortage of garbage trucks in Randburg, Johannesburg. That is why some trash pickups were missed. The DA wants the city to solve the problem.
items.summary_ko: 요하네스버그 랜드버그 지구에서 연료 부족으로 쓰레기 수거 차량이 부족해졌습니다. 그 때문에 일부 쓰레기 수거가 제대로 이뤄지지 않았습니다. 민주동맹(DA)은 시 당국이 이 문제를 해결해 달라고 요구하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Fuel shortages blamed for garbage truck shortage in Randburg

items.raw_excerpt: An increasing number of Swedish households are considering fixing their variable-rate mortgages, according to banking giant SEB's latest Housing Price Indicator.
items.summary_en: More Swedish households are thinking about switching their variable-rate mortgages to fixed rates. Banking group SEB says its latest Housing Price Indicator shows a rise in this trend. People are acting because higher interest rates may be coming.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴의 더 많은 가구가 변동주담보를 고정금리로 바꾸는 방안을 고려하고 있다. 은행 그룹 SEB의 최근 주택가격지수는 이런 흐름이 늘고 있음을 보여준다. 곧 금리가 오를 수 있다는 전망 때문에 사람들이 움직이고 있다.
items.title_en: More Swedes Think About Fixing Mortgage Rates as Hikes Loom

items.title_original: More Swedish households consider fixing mortgage rates as interest hikes loom

items.raw_excerpt: A report on the sale and use of pepper spray for self-defence in the Northern Territory under a government trial has found 3,714 people have bought the product so far, with 46 prohibited buyers identified and three non-lawful deployments recorded.
items.summary_en: The Northern Territory in Australia started a trial that lets people buy pepper spray for self-defence. A new report says 3,714 people have bought it so far. Officials found 46 banned buyers and three uses outside the law.

items.title_en: More than 5,000 pepper spray canisters sold in the NT since start of trial

items.raw_excerpt: Administrative demands and conflicting roles appear to be among the main drivers of burnout among Finnish workers, researchers say.
items.summary_en: Researchers in Finland say burnout is still high among workers. Administrative demands and conflicting roles are among the main causes. They say it is important to define core work and cut unnecessary tasks.
